title: Mod-Specific Category Index
description: Top-level _index.yml for a dedicated mod category. Subcategory _index.yml files use category-index.schema.json.

mod_id.description: The mod's registry namespace / mod ID.

icon.description: Non-binding icon hint. Typically an item from the mod itself.

description.description: Brief description of the mod and what its category covers.

qualified_by.description: Evidence that this mod met the qualification criteria at the time it was added.

item_count.description: Approximate number of unique, distinct items (not variants). Use ~ prefix for estimates.

subcategory_spread.description: Number of generic subcategories the mod's items would span.

modrinth_downloads.description: Modrinth download count at time of nomination.

curseforge_downloads.description: CurseForge download count at time of nomination.

discussion.description: URL of the nomination Discussion thread.

added.description: ISO date when this category was added (YYYY-MM-DD).

deprecated.description: Present only if this mod category is deprecated.
